cc:Work.dc:title: kt hyperbolic range action
cc:Work.dc:description: Exact Poincare disk slice x=0, v=2e1, y_lambda=(tanh lambda,0); full spin-c radial transport to the fixed source and J_lambda square-root density unitary; changing scalar range action and even trivial Gaussian endpoint. The reverse convolution product requires a separate proof.

g.text: Gaussian × 1 is the even trivial line
A scalar source stays fixed through the first-product homotopy.
The reverse A,A product needs a separate convolution-compatible proof.
